descriptionHtml:
Onikuma X91 RGB Gaming Headset with 50mm Drivers and Flexible High-Definition Microphone - Black Edition

Immerse yourself into the core of competitive gameplay and achieve elite auditory performance with the Onikuma X91 RGB Gaming Headset. Available at Turbo Computer, this robust PC hardware audio peripheral is masterfully engineered for tactical esports players, passionate streamers, and active digital website managers across Egypt who demand crisp spatial soundscapes, clear voice transmission, and premium comfort. Featuring an anti-fatigue ergonomic architecture, this headset seamlessly blends high-fidelity acoustic response with sleek, ultra-modern gaming aesthetics.

The Onikuma X91 Black is armed with large high-grade 50mm speaker units optimized to push immersive surround soundscapes with punchy bass layers and sparkling clear high frequencies. It features a fully flexible, high-definition (HD) omnidirectional microphone that incorporates advanced noise reduction filters to capture your natural voice clearly while omitting distracting ambient room clutter. For unmatched luxury during marathon gaming raids, the over-ear cups are loaded with plush, breathable memory foam cushions. Embellished with brilliant multi-zone RGB lighting accents, it provides smooth multi-device plug-and-play compatibility across all your favorite platforms.
